entries.query: jade plastic box music video ird le mint egy image prompg
entries.answer:
Az alábbi leírás egyetlen, filmes „still” jellegű képpé sűríti a **JADE – Plastic Box** klip hangulatát és ikonikus motívumait, hogy közvetlenül bemásolható legyen egy képgenerátorba.[1][2]

## Vizuális kulcselemek
A klip nyitánya egy galériatérben játszódik, ahol az előadó üveg mögé zárva „kiállítási tárgyként” jelenik meg, miközben kíváncsiskodó nézők figyelik.  Ezt a „kalitkából kitörés” gondolat váltja fel, majd több, erősen stilizált pop-előadás vignetta következik koreográfiával és szépség-fókuszú beállításokkal.  A videó visszatérő kelléke egy szív alakú mylar (fólia) lufi, és megjelenik egy hosszú szőke haj/paróka világoskék ruhával is.[3][2][4]

## Image prompt (másolható)
```text
16:9, cinematic film still from a high-fashion pop music video. A contemporary art gallery interior with cold, glossy surfaces and museum lighting. Center frame: a glamorous female pop star displayed behind a large glass box like a living exhibit; soft reflections and glare on the glass. Around the glass: a small crowd of well-dressed onlookers staring curiously, slightly out of focus.

Moment of transformation: the glass looks newly cracked/open as if she has just broken out; dynamic motion blur on her hands and hair. She holds (or a nearby prop features) a heart-shaped silver mylar balloon, slightly wrinkled, catching specular highlights.

Wardrobe/beauty: long platinum-blonde wig, a light blue dress with sleek lines; editorial makeup, sharp contour, glossy lips. Mix polished “beauty setup” lighting with a few subtle lo-fi cutaway vibes (slight grain, imperfect texture) while keeping the main shot premium and cinematic.

Camera: medium-wide shot, low-to-eye level, shallow depth of field, anamorphic feel, high contrast, cool-neutral color grade with metallic highlights. Mood: theatrical, curated, slightly claustrophobic—celebrity as an object on display—then empowered escape.
Negative prompt: text, subtitles, logos, watermark, extra fingers, distorted face, messy typography.
```

## Finomhangolás (opciók)
Ha szeretnél belőle „több jelenetből összevont” montázst egyetlen képre, a promptban a „film still” részt cseréld „collage-like composite frame”-re, és add hozzá: „multiple performance vignettes in the background” (így jobban hozza a koreografált, sok-lookos klipérzetet).  Ha inkább a galériás-üvegkalitkás koncepció legyen a fókusz, vedd ki a „lo-fi cutaway” részt, és erősíts rá: „sterile museum atmosphere, symmetrical composition, harsh top lights”.[2]

## Image prompt (másolható, részletes karakter + styling)

```text
16:9, cinematic film still from a high-fashion pop music video. A contemporary art gallery interior with cold, glossy white walls, museum-quality lighting, and polished concrete or marble floor. Center frame: a young male figure displayed behind a large glass box/vitrine like a living exhibit; soft reflections and specular glare on the glass surface.

CHARACTER DETAIL (lock these features exactly):
• Face: Fair skin, delicate/androgynous bone structure with high cheekbones and a refined, straight nose.
• Eyes: Almond-shaped, slightly hooded, hazel-brown color, with a subtle intensity; dark, naturally groomed brows that are straight and defined.
• Hair: Very short platinum-white/silver bleached hair, swept upward and to the side in a sleek, textured pompadour or quiff style; slightly undercut sides.
• Lips: Medium fullness, natural pink tone, relaxed neutral expression or slight pout.
• Build: Slender, youthful frame; visible collarbones, delicate hands with long fingers.
• Overall vibe: Ethereal, model-like, gender-fluid aesthetic.

WARDROBE (male reinterpretation of the original):
• A fitted light blue/powder blue satin or silk button-down shirt OR a sleek light blue structured blazer over a white tee, tailored slim-fit; subtle sheen to the fabric.
• Alternatively: a glossy light blue bomber jacket or oversized shirt with clean lines.
• Bottoms: Black or charcoal slim-fit trousers or dark jeans (visible only partially in frame).
• Accessories (optional): thin silver chain necklace, rings on fingers; wrist visible holding or near a heart-shaped silver mylar balloon (slightly wrinkled, catching light).

GALLERY SCENE & MOOD:
• Around the glass box: 3-4 well-dressed onlookers (blurred, out of focus) in neutral-toned coats and sweaters, staring curiously like viewing an art installation.
• Lighting: Cool-toned museum lights from above and side; create subtle rim light on the character's hair and shoulders.
• Glass: visible fingerprints, dust particles, and reflections; one corner slightly cracked or ajar as if he's breaking free.
• Prop: the heart-shaped mylar balloon either held in his hand or floating nearby, catching metallic highlights.

MOMENT/EMOTION:
• Capture a moment of transformation: he's either pressing his palm against the glass from the inside (fingers slightly splayed, elegant hand pose) OR just stepping through the cracked opening, with slight motion blur on his hand/hair to suggest dynamic movement.
• Expression: Calm, introspective, slightly melancholic but beautiful—"celebrity as exhibit" transitioning to empowered escape.

CAMERA & GRADING:
• Medium-wide shot, eye-level to slightly low angle.
• Shallow depth of field (f/2.0-2.8), anamorphic lens feel with subtle horizontal flares.
• Color grade: Cool-neutral with desaturated surroundings; the light blue wardrobe and silver balloon pop as the only saturated elements.
• High contrast, editorial fashion lighting, slight film grain for texture.
• Mood: Theatrical, curated, slightly claustrophobic, then liberating.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
Text, logos, watermarks, extra fingers, distorted face, messy typography, female features, long hair, beard, overly masculine jaw, casual streetwear, bright colors, cluttered background.
```

## Finomhangolás (opciók)

- **Ha több jelenet kell egy képbe**: Cseréld a „film still" részt „collage-like composite frame"-re, és add hozzá: „multiple vignettes in the background: one kneeling with the balloon, one in sharp profile, one mid-dance move" – így jobban visszahozza a klip „több lookos" montázsát.
- **Ha inkább a galériás zárt jelenet a fókusz**: Vedd ki a „cracked glass/breaking free" részeket, és erősíts rá: „perfectly sealed glass vitrine, symmetrical composition, sterile museum atmosphere, cold lighting, the boy looks directly at camera with calm defiance."
- **Kellékek extra**: Ha szeretnéd a videó további motívumait (pl. koreográfiás csoportjelenetek, szépség-közeli felvételek), add hozzá: „backup dancers in matching powder blue outfits blurred in the background, or close-up cutaway of his face lit from below with glossy editorial makeup."

Ez a prompt megőrzi az eredeti klip „élő kiállítási tárgy" koncepcióját, de a karaktert minden részletében a fehér/platina hajú fiúra szabja.[1][2]

entries.answer:
A legújabb csatolt fotók () alapján teljesen világos a koncepció. Nem egy "galériában álló emberek" jelenetre van szükség, hanem kifejezetten a **dobozban ülő** kompozícióra, ahol a figura egy fehér posztamensen lévő üvegkockában pózol, kék drapériával, minimál, kékes-szürke "stúdió/múzeum" térben.[1][2][3]

Itt van a javított, sokkal pontosabb prompt, ami ezt a specifikus beállítást írja le a te karakteredre szabva:

## Image Prompt (Copy & Paste)

```text
Cinematic film still, wide shot. A high-fashion conceptual art installation.

THE SCENE:
A large, perfectly square clear glass display case sitting on a solid white minimalistic pedestal. Inside the glass box sits a young male pop star living exhibit. He is sitting on the floor of the box in a relaxed, high-fashion pose (one leg extended, leaning back slightly on hands). The pedestal has a small grey museum label text on the front left corner.

THE SUBJECT (Use attached face reference):
Young male, short platinum/ice-white hair brushed up/textured. Sharp jawline, defined dark eyebrows, neutral but intense "model" gaze.
OUTFIT (Male adaptation of the blue drape dress):
He is wearing a deconstructed, flowing light powder-blue outfit. A sheer/semi-transparent light blue silk shirt that is unbuttoned or draped loosely like a robe, paired with matching loose flowing wide-leg trousers that pool slightly on the floor. The fabric has a soft, ethereal, water-like texture. No suit, no stiffness—it must look fluid and draped like the original reference.

ENVIRONMENT & LIGHTING:
A dark, cool-toned minimal studio space. The background is a gradient of dark blue and grey shadows. To the left and right are faint silhouettes of photographers/paparazzi in the dark, but the main focus is spot-lit on the bright white pedestal and the subject.
Lighting is cold, high-contrast museum spotlighting coming from above, creating clean reflections on the glass walls of the box.

MOOD:
Claustrophobic fame, ethereal beauty, trapped specimen, cold perfection.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
standing up, suit, tie, office wear, warm colors, yellow light, messy room, crowd in focus, smiling, beard, long hair on male, holding phone.
```

### Mit javítottam a képek alapján:
1.  **Póz:** Kivettem a "kitörést". Most **ül a dobozban** (ahogy JADE az eredeti képeken), egyfajta "living specimen" (élő mintadarab) pózban.
2.  **Ruha:** A szatén öltöny helyett **áttetsző, folyékony kék selyem anyagot** írtam (sheer/semi-transparent light blue silk, draped loosely), hogy visszaadja azt a lágy, "vízszerű" esést, ami a JADE ruháján van, de férfias szabásban (bő nadrág + lezser ing).
3.  **Környezet:** Sötétkék/szürke háttér, fehér posztamens (pedestal), rajta a kis múzeumi felirattal.
4.  **Hangulat:** Nem akciójelenet, hanem statikus, "szoborszerű" beállítás.

Ez így már sokkal közelebb lesz ahhoz, amit a csatolt képeken látni.

Oké, átírom úgy, hogy **jobbra nézzen / jobbra forduljon** a srác, minden más maradjon ugyanaz.

## Prompt – „jobbra néző” verzió

```text
Cinematic high-fashion pop music video still, ultra realistic, 4k, 16:9.

A dark modern gallery room in deep blue tones, a large transparent glass cube on a white museum pedestal in the center, white fluffy filling on the floor of the cube. Foreground silhouettes with smartphones filming on both sides, out of focus.

Inside the cube: a young adult male with short icy-white / platinum hair brushed upward and slightly messy, dark defined eyebrows, slim face, sharp jawline, straight nose, natural lips. Fair skin with real texture. He is posed seated on the white filling, legs folded to the side in an elegant editorial pose.

His TORSO faces the camera, but his HEAD AND EYES ARE TURNED TO THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE FRAME (viewer’s left), looking off-screen, avoiding direct eye contact with the audience. Chin slightly raised, expression calm and distant.

Both arms extended with palms pressed against the inside of the glass: the LEFT arm reaching up and out toward the upper-right corner of the cube, the RIGHT arm bent with the hand at chest height, also pressing the glass. Fingers long and elegant, nails natural.

Wardrobe: light-blue satin menswear couture — structured light-blue satin vest or harness with soft draped chiffon over one shoulder, flowing down around his legs; matching light-blue tailored trousers mostly hidden by the drape. Minimal silver rings. No dress, no cleavage.

Cool blue museum lighting from top and front-left, strong specular highlights on the cube edges, subtle reflections but face clearly visible. High contrast, shallow depth of field, slight film grain.

Negative prompt: text, readable letters, watermark, logo, subtitles, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, female body, long hair, casual clothes, mirror selfie, bathroom.
```

Ha szeretnéd, átírom konkrétan Midjourney / SDXL formátumra paraméterekkel is.

Itt a **"fantasy" jelenet** prompt a Plastic Box klipből – ahol az előadó teljesen aranyszínű/vöröses fényes folyadékkal borítva áll glowing oszlopok között havazásban.[1][2]

## Fantasy scene prompt (arany-borított verzió)

```text
Cinematic high-fashion pop music video still, surreal fantasy scene, ultra realistic, 4k, 16:9.

LOCATION / SET:
A dreamlike studio space with a gradient background shifting from blue (top left) to pink/violet (right), soft and glowing. Multiple tall cylindrical white glowing tubes/light columns arranged around the subject at different heights, some in foreground and background, emitting soft white-pink light from inside. Overhead: professional film set lighting rigs and barn door spotlights visible at the top edge of frame, adding a "backstage" theatrical element. Falling snow / white particles gently drifting through the entire scene, backlit and glowing. Floor: dark reflective surface (wet or glossy black).

MAIN SUBJECT (MALE VERSION):
The same young male with short icy-white / platinum hair (textured, slightly messy upward styling), dark defined eyebrows, slim face, sharp jawline, straight nose. His ENTIRE BODY is completely covered in thick, glossy metallic liquid — rose-gold / copper / bronze-toned shimmering paint or resin that looks wet and freshly poured. The liquid drips heavily down his face, chest, arms, and legs in thick streams and rivulets, creating dramatic vertical streaks. His skin underneath is not visible — everything is coated in this reflective metallic substance. Face expression: intense, head slightly tilted back or to the side, eyes gazing upward or directly at camera with a haunting, vulnerable look. Lips slightly parted. Hair also wet and dripping with the metallic liquid.

POSE:
Standing upright in the center of the frame, arms relaxed at his sides or one arm slightly raised. Full-body shot OR medium close-up focusing on torso and face (depending on composition preference). Body language: exposed, vulnerable, statue-like.

WARDROBE:
The metallic liquid acts as the "outfit" — it pools and clings to his body like a second skin. Underneath (implied but not visible): minimal coverage OR a flesh-toned form-fitting garment to suggest nudity while keeping it tasteful. Optional: a few areas where the liquid has formed into draped, fabric-like textures (like a liquid dress or top), especially around the torso — creating the illusion of a metallic gown made of liquid gold/bronze. Texture should look viscous, thick, honey-like, with specular highlights and shadows in the folds.

LIGHTING / COLOR:
Soft diffused key light from front, colored gels creating pink and blue tones mixing with the warm gold/copper of the liquid. Strong rim lighting from behind to make the snowflakes and liquid drips glow. High contrast between the warm metallic body and the cool blue-pink environment. Cinematic color grading: saturated, slightly surreal, dreamlike.

PROPS / DETAILS:
The glowing white cylindrical tubes placed asymmetrically — some close, some far, creating depth. Snow particles in mid-air, motion-blurred slightly. Optional: subtle reflections of the tubes on the wet floor. No readable text, no logos.

CAMERA:
Medium shot to full-body, eye-level or slightly low angle to make the subject feel elevated/heroic. Shallow depth of field: subject sharp, background tubes slightly soft. Anamorphic lens feel, slight vignette.

MOOD:
Otherworldly, vulnerable, raw emotion, "transformation through destruction", visceral beauty, avant-garde art piece.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, distorted face, plastic skin, cartoon, anime, female body, dress with hard edges, dry paint, matte finish, green screen artifacts, overexposed face.
```

## Kiegészítés / variációk
- **Ha közeli felvételt akarsz** (mint a 2. kép): „close-up portrait, focus on face and upper chest, head tilted back, eyes looking up, thick metallic liquid dripping from forehead over closed or half-open eyes, mouth slightly open, dramatic lighting on cheekbones."
- **Ha inkább álló full-body** (mint az 1. kép): „full-body standing pose, arms at sides, centered composition, columns framing the subject on both sides."
